problem: 'Tôi tên là Nguyễn Hải.' tiles 他 阮海 叫 名字 我, key 我 叫 阮海 only. 我 名字 叫 阮海 (的 dropped before 名字, common in speech) is built from the same tiles and rejected; uo-l1-e0 now accepts 我的名字叫阮海, so the course treats the 名字叫 pattern as correct.
fix: Add alternative: 我 名字 叫 阮海 (or drop the 名字 tile so only one sentence can be built).
uncertain: Some teachers still mark 我名字叫… (without 的) as colloquial; it is not wrong.
decision: fixed: alternative 我 名字 叫 阮海 (the tiles build it; 我名字叫… without 的 is colloquial, not wrong, and uo-l1-e0 now takes it typed).

problem: 'Tôi cũng là công nhân.' accepts 我也是工人 | 我也是一个工人 | 我也是1个工人 but not 我也是一名工人 (graded null). uo-l3-e0 'Tôi là công nhân.' accepts 我是一名工人 after pass 1, so the 是一名 + profession form is inconsistent across the course; the one_spellings rule adds 一个 but not 一名.
fix: Add alternative 我也是一名工人, and extend zh_text.one_spellings so 是 + person noun also yields 是一名 + noun wherever it yields 是一个.
decision: fixed: zh_text.one_spellings: 是 + a job also with 一名 (a nationality only with 一个); rule 10 closes it: 我也是一名工人 accepted.

problem: 'Bạn có anh trai không?' accepts 你有哥哥吗 | 你有没有哥哥; the clause-final form 你有哥哥没有 (natural, esp. in northern speech) is rejected.
fix: Add alternative 你有哥哥没有.
decision: fixed: alternative 你有哥哥没有.

problem: 'Nhà vệ sinh ở đâu?' accepts only 洗手间在哪儿 | 洗手间在哪里. 厕所在哪儿 and 卫生间在哪儿 are equally correct renderings of 'nhà vệ sinh' that a learner may already know; rejected. (Typed alternatives are never shown, so no lexeme is needed.)
fix: Add alternatives: 厕所在哪儿 | 厕所在哪里 | 卫生间在哪儿 | 卫生间在哪里
decision: fixed: alternatives 厕所在哪儿 / 卫生间在哪儿 (+ 哪里 by the natural pairs); typed alternatives are never shown, so no lexeme is needed.

problem: 'Bây giờ là mấy giờ?' accepts 现在几点 | 现在几点了 only. 现在是几点 (the prompt itself says 'là', and 是 before a time is fully grammatical) is graded wrong; 现在几点钟 is also rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 现在是几点 | 现在几点钟 | 现在是几点钟
decision: fixed: alternatives 现在是几点 / 现在几点钟 / 现在是几点钟.

problem: 'Tôi từng đến Trung Quốc.' accepts 我去过中国 | 我来过中国; 我到过中国 and 我曾经去过中国 (曾经 = từng, the learner's literal choice) are correct and rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我到过中国 | 我曾经去过中国 | 我曾经来过中国
decision: fixed: alternatives 我到过中国 / 我曾经去过中国 / 我曾经来过中国.

problem: 'Tôi học tiếng Trung.' accepts 我学习汉语 | 我学汉语 | 我学习中文 | 我学中文 but not the progressive 我在学汉语 / 我在学中文, which is the commonest way to say 'I am learning Chinese' and fits the Vietnamese.
fix: Add alternatives: 我在学汉语 | 我在学中文 | 我在学习汉语 | 我在学习中文
decision: fixed: alternatives 我在学汉语 / 我在学中文 / 我在学习汉语 / 我在学习中文.

problem: 'Mùa thu thời tiết rất đẹp.' accepts 秋天天气很好 | 秋天的天气很好 | 秋天天气非常好 | 秋天天气真好, but the 的 form only with 很: 秋天的天气非常好 and 秋天的天气真好 (each combines two accepted choices) are graded wrong.
fix: Add alternatives: 秋天的天气非常好 | 秋天的天气真好 (or let the generator cross the optional 的 with the degree adverbs).
decision: fixed: alternatives 秋天的天气非常好 / 秋天的天气真好.

problem: 'Hôm nay nóng.' accepts 今天很热 | 今天热 | 今天非常热 | 今天天气很热 | 今天天气热; 今天好热 and 今天天气非常热 (natural, same meaning) are rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 今天好热 | 今天天气非常热 | 今天真热
decision: fixed: alternatives 今天好热 / 今天真热 / 今天天气非常热.

problem: 'Hằng ngày tôi tắm.' accepts 我每天洗澡 | 每天我洗澡 only. 我每天都洗澡 / 每天我都洗澡 — 每天 … 都 is the standard collocation many learners are taught — are graded wrong.
fix: Add alternatives: 我每天都洗澡 | 每天我都洗澡 (and consider a generator rule: 每天 + V ⇄ 每天都 + V in typed keys).
decision: fixed: zh_text.dou_spellings: 每天 + verb phrase also with 都 (rule 10 closes every answer; it reached uj-l1-e6, uo-l2-e1, uu-l3-e5): 我每天都洗澡 / 每天我都洗澡 accepted.

problem: 'Tôi sống ở ký túc xá.' accepts 我住在宿舍 | 我住宿舍 | 我在宿舍住; 我住在宿舍里 (locative 里, very common) is rejected. Same on uc-l0-e7 ('Tôi ở ký túc xá.': 我在宿舍里 rejected).
fix: Add alternatives: 我住在宿舍里 | 我在宿舍里住; uc-l0-e7 + 我在宿舍里 | 我住在宿舍里
decision: fixed: alternatives 我住在宿舍里 (+ 我在宿舍里住 by the 住 order rule); uc-l0-e7 + 我在宿舍里 / 我住在宿舍里.

problem: 'Bạn về nhà mấy giờ?' key 你几点回家 with no alternatives; 你几点钟回家 is rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 你几点钟回家
decision: fixed: alternative 你几点钟回家.

problem: 'Tổ trưởng giúp bạn khiêng thùng hàng. Hãy cảm ơn anh ấy.' Speech items are whole-utterance only (no requiredConcepts), so the vocative-first order 组长，谢谢您 / 组长，谢谢 (as natural as the listed 谢谢组长) fails, and so do 非常感谢您 and 太感谢了 while 非常感谢 and 太谢谢了 pass (ran the grader).
fix: Add variants: 组长谢谢您 | 组长谢谢 | 组长谢谢你 | 非常感谢您 | 太感谢了 | 谢谢您组长 — or give the item requiredConcepts [[谢谢, 感谢]].
decision: fixed: engine (root cause c): the zh plugin's utteranceFrame lets a whole spoken answer carry 嗯 / 那 in front, a vocative before or after (组长，谢谢 · 谢谢您，组长 · 王经理，早上好) and a final particle where it changes nothing (啊 / 呀; 了 after an age or 明白 / 懂 / 知道; 吧 after a request or 见; 呢 after a question word); content words stay exact (组长，谢谢您 · 谢谢您，组长 · 谢谢啊); variants + 非常感谢您 / 太感谢了 / 太谢谢您了; the lesson exercise uk-l1-e8 mirrors the item.

problem: 'Bạn đến muộn năm phút. Hãy xin lỗi tổ trưởng.' 对不起，我迟到了五分钟 (states the cue fact), 组长，对不起，我迟到了 (vocative) and 不好意思，我晚到了 (while 对不起，我晚到了 is listed) all fail the whole-utterance match.
fix: Add variants: 对不起我迟到了五分钟 | 不好意思我迟到了五分钟 | 组长对不起我迟到了 | 组长不好意思我迟到了 | 不好意思我晚到了 — or requiredConcepts [[对不起, 不好意思]].
decision: fixed: engine (root cause c): the zh plugin's utteranceFrame lets a whole spoken answer carry 嗯 / 那 in front, a vocative before or after (组长，谢谢 · 谢谢您，组长 · 王经理，早上好) and a final particle where it changes nothing (啊 / 呀; 了 after an age or 明白 / 懂 / 知道; 吧 after a request or 见; 呢 after a question word); content words stay exact (组长，对不起，我迟到了); variants + 不好意思，我晚到了 / 对不起，我迟到了五分钟 / 不好意思，我迟到了五分钟 / 对不起，我晚到了五分钟.

problem: 'Hãy xin phép về trước.' 我先回去了 (the commonest alternative to 我先走了), 我走了，明天见 and 我先走了，拜拜 (拜拜 is a course word) are rejected.
fix: Add variants: 我先回去了 | 我先回家了 | 我走了明天见 | 我先走了拜拜 | 我先走了明天见啊
decision: fixed: variants + 我先回去了 / 我先回家了 / 我走了，明天见 / 我先走了，拜拜 / 我先回去了，明天见; 我先走了，明天见啊 by the engine frame (root cause c).

problem: 'Hãy mở lời lịch sự' (asking a stranger the way): 打扰一下 and 请问一下 are standard openers and fail.
fix: Add variants: 请问一下 | 打扰一下 | 打扰一下请问 | 不好意思打扰一下
decision: fixed: variants + 请问一下 / 打扰一下 / 打扰一下，请问 / 不好意思，打扰一下 (recognised answers are never shown, so 打扰 needs no lexeme).

problem: 'Tôi hiểu rồi.' accepts 我明白了 | 明白了 | 我懂了; 懂了 (parallel to the accepted 明白了) is rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 懂了
decision: fixed: alternative 懂了.

problem: Cue Tên: Nguyễn Hải. 我的名字叫阮海 fails although the typed twin uo-l1-e0 accepts it (pass-1 fix); 你好，我是阮海 fails while 你好，我叫阮海 passes; 大家好，我叫阮海 (the interview opener) fails. Ran the grader.
fix: Add variants: 我的名字叫阮海 | 你好我是阮海 | 您好我是阮海 | 大家好我叫阮海 | 大家好我是阮海
decision: fixed: variant 我的名字叫阮海, and a generator rule in zh-speech-s4.py: every 我叫 / 我是 / 我姓 / 我的名字 answer of the name item also opens with 你好 / 您好 / 大家好 (14 forms); the twins cp4_name_hua and pl_name_nam take them all.

problem: Cue Tuổi: 25. 我今年二十五岁了 — 今年 … 岁了 is the most natural way to state one's age — fails; the typed question ul-l1-e5 accepts 你今年几岁了, so the course itself uses the 了.
fix: Add variants: 我今年二十五岁了 | 今年我二十五岁了 | 我二十五岁了
decision: fixed: engine (root cause c): the zh plugin's utteranceFrame lets a whole spoken answer carry 嗯 / 那 in front, a vocative before or after (组长，谢谢 · 谢谢您，组长 · 王经理，早上好) and a final particle where it changes nothing (啊 / 呀; 了 after an age or 明白 / 懂 / 知道; 吧 after a request or 见; 呢 after a question word); content words stay exact, and zh_text.age_spellings: a clause-final age also with 了 (rule 10; it reached ul-l0-e6, uo-l1-e2 and the age speech items): 我今年二十五岁了 accepted.

problem: 'Năm nay tôi hai mươi tuổi.' accepts 我今年二十岁 | 我今年20岁 | 今年我二十岁 | 今年我20岁; 我今年二十岁了 (and the 20 and 今年我 forms with 了) is rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我今年二十岁了 | 我今年20岁了 | 今年我二十岁了 | 今年我20岁了
decision: fixed: zh_text.age_spellings: a clause-final age also with 了 (rule 10; it reached ul-l0-e6, uo-l1-e2 and the age speech items): 我今年二十岁了 / 我今年20岁了 / 今年我二十岁了 / 今年我20岁了 accepted.

problem: Cue Nước: Việt Nam. 我来自越南 fails although the typed twin uo-l3-e2 accepts it after pass 1 (来自 = 'lai tự', the likeliest Vietnamese-speaker phrasing).
fix: Add variant: 我来自越南
decision: fixed: variant 我来自越南 (the twin cp4_vietnamese takes it too).

problem: Cue nhà máy: 我在一个工厂工作 (spoken 一个 for 一家) and 我在工厂里工作 fail; 我在一家工厂工作 passes.
fix: Add variants: 我在一个工厂工作 | 我在工厂里工作 | 我在工厂里上班
decision: fixed: variants + 我在一个工厂工作 / 我在工厂里工作 / 我在工厂里上班 (the twin cp4_work_shop takes them with 超市).

problem: 'Tôi thích âm nhạc.' accepts 我喜欢音乐 | 我喜欢听音乐 | 我爱音乐; 我爱听音乐 (accepted by the twin writing slot zh.write.cp5_like_music) is rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 我爱听音乐
decision: fixed: alternative 我爱听音乐.

problem: 'Tôi biết nói tiếng Trung.' accepts 我会说汉语 | 我会说中文; 我会讲中文 / 我会说普通话 are correct and rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我会讲中文 | 我会讲汉语 | 我会说普通话
decision: fixed: alternatives 我会讲中文 / 我会讲汉语 / 我会说普通话.

problem: 'Hãy nói bạn muốn hai vé.' accepts 我要两张票 | 两张票 | 请给我两张票 | 给我两张票 | 我买两张票; 我想要两张票, 我想买两张票 and 我要买两张票 — the literal rendering of 'muốn' and the commonest ticket-desk phrasing — fail (ran the grader).
fix: Add variants: 我想要两张票 | 我想买两张票 | 我要买两张票 | 我要两张
decision: fixed: variants + 我想要两张票 / 我想买两张票 / 我要买两张票 / 我要两张 (+ digit forms); the twin cp4_tickets_three takes them with 三.

problem: Time replies with 钟 (八点钟, 现在八点钟) fail; the same gap is in the two reserved time items.
fix: Add 八点钟 | 现在八点钟 (十点钟 / 九点钟 in the reserved items).
decision: fixed: variants + 八点钟 / 现在八点钟 / 现在是八点钟; the twins cp4_time_ten and a1cap_time_nine take them with 十 / 九.

problem: 我生日五月十号 (no 的, no 是) fails, though the typed twin ud-l1-e7 accepts 我生日五月五号 after pass 1.
fix: Add variants: 我生日五月十号 | 我生日五月十日
decision: fixed: variant 我生日五月十号 (+ 日); the twin a1cap_birthday takes 我生日九月二十号.

problem: 'Một vị khách hỏi giá một bát mì.' 一碗面条十八块 / 面条一碗十八块 (naming the noodles) fail while 面条十八块 passes.
fix: Add variants: 一碗面条十八块 | 面条一碗十八块 | 面条十八块一碗
decision: fixed: variants + 一碗面条十八块 / 面条一碗十八块 (+ 面条十八块一碗 and the 钱 forms by the price rule); the twins cp4_price_tea and a1cap_price_coffee take them with their noun and price.

problem: 'Hãy nói hôm nay là thứ mấy.' 今天周一 (周一 is everyday spoken Chinese) fails.
fix: Add variants: 今天周一 | 周一 | 今天是周一
decision: fixed: zh_text.week_spellings: 星期一 ⇄ 周一, 星期天 / 星期日 ⇄ 周日 (rule 10; typed answers, speech items, the day slots of writing): 今天周一 / 周一 / 今天是周一 accepted; the twins cp4_day_friday and a1cap_day_sunday take 周五 / 周日.

problem: 'Số điện thoại của bạn là bao nhiêu?' accepts 你的电话号码是多少 | 你电话号码是多少 | 你的电话是多少; 你电话是多少 and 你的号码是多少 are rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 你电话是多少 | 你的号码是多少 | 你号码是多少
decision: fixed: alternatives 你电话是多少 / 你的号码是多少 / 你号码是多少.

problem: 'Chúng ta gặp lúc ba giờ chiều.' 我们下午三点见吧 (吧 for a proposal is natural) is rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我们下午三点见吧 | 我们下午三点见面吧
decision: fixed: alternatives 我们下午三点见吧 / 我们下午三点见面吧 (+ digit and order forms).

problem: 'Cái này rẻ hơn cái kia.' key 这个比那个便宜 with no alternatives. 这个比那个更便宜 and 这个比那个便宜一点(儿) — the two commonest comparative forms after the bare one — are graded wrong.
fix: Add alternatives: 这个比那个更便宜 | 这个比那个便宜一点 | 这个比那个便宜一点儿 | 这个比那个便宜点儿
decision: fixed: alternatives 这个比那个更便宜 / 这个比那个便宜一点儿 (+ 一点 / 点儿 / 点 by the natural pairs and the 一点儿 rule).

problem: The picture-description items accept 很 / 非常 + adjective but not 真 / 好 (这个箱子真大, 房间真干净), the everyday exclamatory description; 她个子很高 also fails for n_person.
fix: Add 真 / 好 forms to the describe items (这个箱子真大 | 这个箱子好大 …), and 她个子很高 to n_person.
decision: fixed: a generator rule in zh-speech-s4.py: every 很 + adjective answer of a description item also with 真 and 好 (这个箱子真大, 房间真干净; n_box, n_car, n_cat, n_room, n_person and the description twins); n_person + 她个子很高.

problem: Open task 'Hãy viết vài câu về bạn. Bạn chọn nói gì cũng được.' has one menu slot about = 是 | 叫 | 住 | 喜欢 | 工作. Correct self-descriptions without those five verbs fail with the false feedback 'đừng quên một câu về bạn': 我有两个妹妹。我今年二十岁。 and 我家有四口人。我在河内。 both grade does_not_meet_rubric (ran evaluateGuidedWriting).
fix: Widen the menu with the course's other self-description patterns: 有 | 岁 | 今年 | 在 | 家 | 会 | 想 | 爱 (open mode, so several hits are fine).
decision: fixed: menu widened with the course's self-description patterns: + 有 / 岁 / 今年 / 在 / 家 / 会 / 想 / 爱 (open mode, never scored); 我有两个妹妹。我今年二十岁。 and 我家有四口人。我在河内。 meet it.

problem: 'Năm nay tôi hai mươi ba tuổi.' 我今年二十三岁了 (and 23岁了, 今年我…岁了) is rejected — same gap as ul-l0-e6; the writing twin zh.write.o_age accepts 我二十三岁了.
fix: Add the 了 forms: 我今年二十三岁了 | 我今年23岁了 | 今年我二十三岁了 | 今年我23岁了
decision: fixed: zh_text.age_spellings: a clause-final age also with 了 (rule 10; it reached ul-l0-e6, uo-l1-e2 and the age speech items): 我今年二十三岁了 (+ 23 and 今年我 forms) accepted.

problem: 'Hằng ngày tôi làm việc ở nhà máy.' accepts 我每天在工厂工作 | 每天我在工厂工作; 我每天都在工厂工作 (每天 … 都) and 我每天在工厂上班 (the course's own synonym, accepted in zh.speak.l_work) are rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我每天都在工厂工作 | 每天我都在工厂工作 | 我每天在工厂上班 | 我每天都在工厂上班
decision: fixed: alternative 我每天在工厂上班, and zh_text.dou_spellings: 每天 + verb phrase also with 都 (rule 10 closes every answer; it reached uj-l1-e6, uo-l2-e1, uu-l3-e5): 我每天都在工厂工作 / 我每天都在工厂上班 / 每天我都在工厂工作 accepted.

problem: 'Tôi làm việc ở một công ty Trung Quốc.' accepts 我在一家中国公司工作 | 我在中国公司工作; spoken-style 我在一个中国公司工作 is rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 我在一个中国公司工作
decision: fixed: alternative 我在一个中国公司工作.

problem: 'Tôi tên là Nguyễn Hải.' accepts 我的名字叫阮海 but not 我名字叫阮海 (的 dropped, common in speech); see also the word bank u1-l2-e6.
fix: Add alternatives: 我名字叫阮海 | 我名字是阮海
decision: fixed: alternatives 我名字叫阮海 / 我名字是阮海.

problem: 'Buổi sáng anh Nguyễn Nam uống cà phê.' Slot drink = 喝咖啡 is a contiguous run, so 阮南早上喝一杯咖啡 and 阮南早上喝了咖啡 (both correct) grade does_not_meet_rubric with 'missing: uống cà phê' (ran evaluateGuidedWriting: tokens 喝 一 杯 咖啡 / 喝 了 咖啡).
fix: drink: 喝咖啡 | 喝一杯咖啡 | 喝了咖啡 | 喝杯咖啡 — or split into two slots (喝, 咖啡). The class recurs in every V+O slot (see zh.write.p_link).
decision: fixed: engine (root cause a): a writing slot takes the insertions the zh plugin declares (src/lib/languages/zh.ts slotRuns, matched by src/lib/languages/runs.ts) — 了 / 过 / 着, 完, 一下 / 点儿, a measure word with or without its numeral, a surname before a title — between its words or inside a separable word; a wrong word still fails: 阮南早上喝一杯咖啡 and 阮南早上喝了咖啡 meet the drink slot; the slot keeps 喝咖啡 alone.

problem: Pass-1 fix incomplete. The pass-1 example 我吃了早饭以后去上班 still fails: link (以后) and work now pass but breakfast = 吃早饭 is a contiguous run and 吃 了 早饭 breaks it. 吃完早饭以后，我去上班 fails the same way, and 我先吃早餐，然后去工厂 fails (早餐 not accepted). Ran the grader on all three.
fix: breakfast: 吃早饭 | 吃了早饭 | 吃完早饭 | 吃早餐 | 吃了早餐 | 早饭 (or a slot on 早饭 / 早餐 alone).
decision: fixed: engine (root cause a): a writing slot takes the insertions the zh plugin declares (src/lib/languages/zh.ts slotRuns, matched by src/lib/languages/runs.ts) — 了 / 过 / 着, 完, 一下 / 点儿, a measure word with or without its numeral, a surname before a title — between its words or inside a separable word; a wrong word still fails (吃了早饭, 吃完早饭); breakfast + 吃早餐 (早餐 is never shown); the three examples meet the rubric.

problem: Two correct messages fail (ran evaluateGuidedWriting): (1) 李组长，早上好！我发烧了，今天想请假。 — 早上好 is one lexeme token, so greeting = 您好|你好|组长好|经理好 is missing; (2) 李组长，您好！我发烧了，今天想请一天假。 — the split form 请一天假 (the most natural way to ask for one day) does not contain the run 请假. 今天不去上班了 also fails the rest slot.
fix: greeting: + 早上好 | 早 | 晚上好 | 组长早 | 您早; rest: + 请一天假 | 请个假 | 请天假 | 不去上班 | 不上班 | 不能去上班
decision: fixed: writing greeting slots (zh-writing-s5 GREET, shared by q_sick, q_late, cp5_note_sick, cp5_mail_shift, a1cap_mail_absent): + 早上好 / 晚上好 / 下午好 / 早 / 组长早 / 经理早 / 您早; REST (q_sick, cp5_note_sick, a1cap_mail_absent): + 不去上班 / 不上班 / 不能去上班 / 不能来上班 / 不来上班; 请一天假 by the engine (root cause a): a writing slot takes the insertions the zh plugin declares (src/lib/languages/zh.ts slotRuns, matched by src/lib/languages/runs.ts) — 了 / 过 / 着, 完, 一下 / 点儿, a measure word with or without its numeral, a surname before a title — between its words or inside a separable word; a wrong word still fails. All three examples meet the rubric.

problem: 王经理，早上好！公交车来晚了，对不起！ fails: 早上好 is one token and the greeting slot (您好|你好|组长好|经理好) has no time-of-day greeting, though a late-arrival message is written in the morning.
fix: greeting: + 早上好 | 早 | 经理早 | 您早 (apply to every writing greeting slot: the same list is used by q_sick and the cp5 notes).

problem: 'Máy bị hỏng, xin gọi tổ trưởng đến.' Correct notes fail (ran evaluateGuidedWriting): 机器坏了，请找组长来 (找 = the everyday 'go get'), 机器坏了，请叫一下组长 (叫 一下 组长 breaks the 叫组长 run), 机器坏了，请叫李组长来 (the name breaks it), and 机器出问题了，请叫组长来 (broken slot has 有问题 but not 出问题).
fix: call: + 找组长 | 叫一下组长 | 找一下组长 | 组长 (as a cue-like noun slot) — simplest: call = 组长 and keep the verb free; broken: + 出问题 | 出问题了 | 不能用了
decision: fixed: call + 找组长 / 请组长来 / 让组长来; 叫一下组长 and 叫李组长 by the engine (root cause a): a writing slot takes the insertions the zh plugin declares (src/lib/languages/zh.ts slotRuns, matched by src/lib/languages/runs.ts) — 了 / 过 / 着, 完, 一下 / 点儿, a measure word with or without its numeral, a surname before a title — between its words or inside a separable word; a wrong word still fails; broken + 出问题 / 不能用了. The reviewer's 'call = 组长' was not taken: a bare 组长 would pass a note that mentions the leader without calling him.

problem: Pass-1 fix incomplete. decision: fixed: engine (root cause b): slot words match the segmenter's tokens joined (138 1234 5678 = 13812345678), never inside a longer token: 138 1234 5678, 13812345678 and 138-1234-5678 meet all five phone slots (r_form_bank, r_form_dorm, cp5_form_bank, cp5_form_clinic, cp5_form_work), each checked in the three spellings; the pass-1 claim is corrected in zh_text.variant_spellings (the hyphen is a token of its own).

problem: Systemic: no zh speech item has requiredConcepts, so only listed whole utterances pass, and nothing covers the two most frequent spoken expansions: a sentence-final particle (谢谢啊, 晚上好啊, 对不起啊, 大家早上好啊 all fail; pl_hello lists 你好啊 by hand, the others do not) and a leading vocative (组长，谢谢 / 组长，对不起 / 王经理，早上好 fail). The per-item findings above are instances of this class.
fix: Add a generator rule in zh-speech-s4.py (like the pass-1 order rules): for situation/formulaic items, add each variant + 啊 (and 呀 where natural) and vocative + variant for the addressee the prompt names (组长, 经理, 王经理, 大家); or give formulaic items requiredConcepts on the core formula ([[谢谢, 感谢]], [[对不起, 不好意思]], [[早上好, 早]]).
